top_signals.title: Laredo hits low-balance truck toll accounts with fines up to $2,000
top_signals.summary:
Commercial carriers crossing through Laredo’s international freight bridges now face escalating penalties and possible account suspension for insufficient toll account balances.

The post Laredo hits low-balance truck toll accounts with fines up to $2,000 appeared first on FreightWaves.
